ADA COMPLIANCE

The lot is the part that gets cited.

If you are on this page you are either coming off an inspection or you have a feeling about one. The lot is the cheapest part of an ADA complaint to fix and the easiest to see from the parking area, which is why it is the part that gets cited.

Send me the checklist Walk my lot

One checklist, sent once. It is not a subscription.

What the walk-around covers

  • The number of accessible stalls your total stall count actually requires
  • Van accessible stall and access aisle dimensions, and the mistakes that show up most
  • Where the signs go, how high they mount and which ones your lot needs
  • Slope limits, and why a lot that passed ten years ago can fail today
  • The route from the accessible stall to your front door, where most lots actually fail

Real lots, real crew

Nothing on this page came from a stock library.

Which is worth saying, because most of the sites you are comparing did buy theirs.

Home › Services › Sealcoating

Asphalt sealcoating in Wichita

Asphalt fails from the top down and from the inside out at the same time. Sun oxidises the surface, water gets into what the sun opened up, and Kansas freezes it. Sealcoat is the layer that keeps that sequence from starting.

What the job includes

Scope

  • 01Commercial lot sealcoating
  • 02Surface cleaning and prep before seal goes down
  • 03Oil spot priming
  • 04Crack sealing ahead of the seal coat
  • 05Restriping after the seal cures

Do I need to restripe after sealcoating?

Yes. Seal goes over everything, so the lines go down again afterward. That is why the two get quoted together, and it is also the moment to fix a layout that was never right in the first place.

How long does the lot need to stay closed?

Withheld. Devin's real cure window is not confirmed yet, so this answer does not render.

Home › ADA Compliance

KANSAS

ADA parking compliance in Kansas.

If you are on this page you are either coming off an inspection or you have a feeling about one. Either way, the lot is the part of an ADA complaint that is cheapest to fix and easiest to see from the parking area, which is why it is the part that gets cited.

Walk my lot Send me the checklist

Where lots actually fail

It is usually not the stall.

Most lots that fail do not fail on the stall. They fail on the aisle, the sign height, or the route to the door. Those are the three the crew checks first.

  • 01Accessible stall and access aisle layout to current standards
  • 02Van accessible stalls and the wider aisle they need
  • 03Accessible route from stall to entrance
  • 04ADA signage, supplied and installed at correct mounting height
  • 05Restriping existing accessible stalls that have faded or drifted
  • 06Walk the lot and tell you what is out, before you commit to anything

Can you tell me if my lot is out of compliance before I commit to anything?

Yes, and that is the usual way it starts. Devin walks it, tells you what is out and what it takes to fix, and you decide from there. There is no charge for being told your lot is fine.

Withheld until the stall count table is verified against the 2010 ADA Standards. No figure goes on this page from memory.
